title: Ontology mapping
summary: Compare source terminology against supplied concepts and explicit definitions.

sections.label: Inputs
sections.text: Relevant source passage, a bounded candidate concept list, definitions, and scope constraints. Use existing retrieval to shortlist candidates rather than pass an entire ontology.

sections.label: Output
sections.text: Selected concept or explicit none/uncertain, linked to the source and candidate set. Keep new-concept proposals separate from mappings to approved concepts.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: Evaluate semantic mapping errors, especially neighboring concepts and missing correct alternatives. Domain review and deterministic schema checks still apply.

catalog.applicability: Use this Jev example when mapping source terminology to a bounded candidate list of supplied concepts with definitions and scope constraints. Shortlist candidates with existing retrieval and keep new-concept proposals separate from mappings to approved concepts.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
